system.name: VideoTemp-o3
system.one_liner: A unified agentic thinking-with-videos model that jointly does temporal grounding and QA, localising, clipping and refining segments on demand.

content.variant_note: one real video-QA instance followed over three agent turns, with the real think text, tool calls and returned clips shown as film strips; a colour key ties span highlights to four task types
content.argues: One model can ground a segment on demand, refine its timestamps after inspecting the clip, and then answer from the evidence found, all within a single multi-turn trace.
content.subject: A real Titanic-video question answered over three agent turns with two clip tool calls, a timestamp refinement and a final answer.

elements.name: How many ships are shown in the map while the sinking ship sending out message? A. 3 B. 8 C. 11 D. 9
elements.role: the multiple-choice video question given by the user
elements.drawn_as: rounded bordered box at the top left beside a user avatar, options in one line

elements.name: Turn 1: Grounding
elements.role: first agent turn: think text locating a map scene, ending in a tool call with a rough segment
elements.drawn_as: bordered rounded text box with a bold title, the closing <tool_call>[215, 224]</tool_call> highlighted dark orange (#e87032)

elements.name: Clip [215, 224]
elements.role: the clip returned by the first tool call: it turns out to show magazine and newspaper pages
elements.drawn_as: small dark film strip of tilted frames under the Turn 1 box, reached by an arrow with a scissors icon and the label

elements.name: Timestamp Refine
elements.role: the model inspects the first clip and corrects the segment in the next turn
elements.drawn_as: orange circular-arrows icon with bold orange label, joined to Turn 2 by an orange curved arrow that leaves the first clip strip

elements.name: Turn 2: Grounding
elements.role: second agent turn: re-examines the video, finds the correct map and calls a refined segment
elements.drawn_as: bordered text box, re-examination sentences shaded peach (#f6c6ad) and <tool_call>[312, 325]</tool_call> dark orange

elements.name: Clip [312, 325]
elements.role: the clip returned by the refined call, showing ship blueprints and map frames
elements.drawn_as: dark film strip with tilted frames, one map frame enlarged and outlined in thick red, reached by a scissors arrow

elements.name: Turn 3: Answer
elements.role: final turn: reasons over the map in the clip, counts the labelled ships and answers
elements.drawn_as: bordered text box, the ship-listing reasoning shaded pale green (#c2f1c8)

elements.name: <answer>C</answer>
elements.drawn_as: closing tag of the Turn 3 text, highlighted green (#4ea62e)

elements.name: Unify multiple tasks
elements.role: key tying the four highlight colours to Video Grounding, Timestamp Refine, Video QA and Visual Reasoning
elements.drawn_as: light-grey (#e8e8e8) rounded panel at the lower left with a heading and four colour swatches with names

encoding.color_means: four task colours: dark orange = video grounding, peach = timestamp refine, green = video QA, pale green = visual reasoning; the same colours shade spans in the turn texts and fill the key swatches; red = the evidence frame
encoding.line_style_means: black straight arrows = turn-to-turn and tool-call flow; the orange curved arrow = timestamp refinement carried into the next turn
encoding.shape_means: dark film strip with sprocket holes = a video or a clip; rounded bordered box = one turn or the question; scissors = clip tool; circular arrows = refine
encoding.marker_means: Turn 1, 2, 3 order the agent's steps; [start, end] pairs in the tool_call tags and Clip labels are timestamps in seconds
encoding.emphasis: dark-orange tool_call highlights and the thick red frame draw the eye to the grounding calls and the evidence; film strips fill the top; the key states the four task types
reusable_patterns: agent trace as stacked bordered text boxes (Turn 1, 2, 3) whose think, tool_call and answer text is highlighted by task colour
tool output drawn as the real media it returns: a film strip under the turn, reached by an arrow with a scissors icon and a Clip [a, b] label
full-width film strip on top standing for the whole video, clips as smaller strips below
orange loop icon and curved arrow labelled Timestamp Refine carrying one clip back into the next turn
key panel pairing colour swatches with task names, matched by span highlights
thick red outline on the one frame that carries the evidence

lessons.what_to_learn: Show an agent's multi-turn trace as stacked bordered text boxes whose tags (think, tool_call, answer) are highlighted in one colour per task type, draw each tool output as the real media it returns (film-strip clips), and add a key that ties the colours to the task names.
lessons.suits: agentic video or multimodal systems where one model interleaves grounding, tool calls and reasoning across turns on a real example.

evidence: Figure 1. Illustration of the agentic pipeline in VideoTemp-o3.
it performs on-demand grounding and refines the initial rough segment
enabling iterative refinement until sufficient evidence is gathered to produce a reliable answer

summary: VideoTemp-o3 is a unified agentic thinking-with-videos framework that jointly models video grounding and question answering, supports on-demand clipping and can refine inaccurate localisations. Figure 1 follows one real example: a long Titanic documentary (a full-width film strip) and a question about how many ships the map shows. In Turn 1 the model's think text ends in a dark-orange tool call [215, 224]; a scissors arrow returns that clip as a small film strip. An orange Timestamp Refine loop carries it into Turn 2, which re-examines the video and calls [312, 325]; the returned clip has the map frame outlined in red. Turn 3 reasons over the map and answers C. A grey key ties four highlight colours to Video Grounding, Timestamp Refine, Video QA and Visual Reasoning.
summary_zh: VideoTemp-o3 是统一的智能体式视频思考框架，同时做时间定位与问答。图以泰坦尼克号长视频问题分三轮：先剪出 [215,224]，再细化为 [312,325]，最后基于地图帧推理答 C；左下图例用四色对应四类任务。
notes: The prior attribute panels=4 was not followed: the Turn boxes are steps of one trace, not panels. Frame counts of the two clip strips are approximate (the digest gives 27 bitmaps in total: 15 for the top strip and 12 for the two clips). The mapping of peach and pale-green spans to Timestamp Refine and Visual Reasoning follows the key and the visible highlights.
